recipe.checkpoint_access: Parent-owned initial_common and selected last.pt are allowed only after release; separately count actual parent_checkpoint_reads and hash reads.
recipe.prediction_scope: Two fixed DEV/ver cases, both arms, all original nodes and unchanged parent71grid/16latent/local86 architecture and saved scalers.
recipe.parent_costs: Immutable context only; never reset or refill parent1800s budget
recipe.evidence_gate: Complete finite fixed-endpoint predictions/metrics only; no parent-pair pass or fair600s600s/capacity ranking
recipe.skip: Complete parent metrics for both arms => no scientific readout/import/array/weight/GT access

science_recipe.input_interface: FullFE physics supplies immutable original zero-start U plus recovered raw sigma6/valid. Geometry xyz/original25/cloud are same across arms; different supplied information from pointcloud-only solver benchmark. No displacement GT input.

recipe.original25: Preserve exact canonical original25, no reinterpretation of undocumented channels
recipe.geometry: Same canonical xyz and accepted1024-node cloud/mask; common PointNet32 width64 trained
recipe.physical_query: Physical uXYZ3 + raw sigma6 + valid1 always reach local decoder directly; invalid sigma normalized slots zero with separate validity flag
recipe.common_local_decoder: 86 inputs: xyz3+original25+physicalU3+sigma6+valid1+PointNet32+global_latent16; four hidden256 ReLU, scalar1 unbounded encoded signed S
recipe.common_initialization: Initialize PointNet/common86-input head once with seed2026; clone exact state to both arms before independent FNO creation. Common TRAIN normalizers and original-S scaler. No pretrained neural weights.
recipe.local_arm: Exactly zero16 global latent tokens, otherwise identical local inputs/head/cloud
recipe.grid: Target-free trilinear mean splat of original25+normalized physicalU3+normalized sigma6+valid1 =35, with occupancy1+coordinate3+PointNet32 =>71 channels; node-splat occupancy, not FE volume occupancy
recipe.query: Use geobc.fno.query_grid arbitrary16-channel latent at every original node, concatenate to local decoder. No sigma-only voxel washout, no scalar-S grid supervision.
recipe.normalizers: Reuse immutable TRAIN3-only sigma mean/std and original signed-asinh q90 mean/std from parent scalers; fit one shared zero-center component RMS for TRAIN3 predicted physicalU only, floor1e-12mm. DEV fits0. xyz/original25 unchanged.
recipe.loss: Full-original-node case-mean encoded S squared error; node-weighted chunk backward, exactly one Adam update per complete CAD
recipe.optimizer: Adam lr0.001 weight_decay0; FP32/TF32 matching prior decoder, FFT remains FP32, no autocast
recipe.balanced_case_order: Independent Random(2026) shuffled TRAIN3 balanced passes, identical ordered prefix for both arms; all3 complete before endpoint
recipe.training_budget: Each arm stops only after first full balanced3 pass with cumulative actual training_seconds>=600; report overshoot. Training timer includes actual case cache I/O/H2D, context/FNO forward, fullN query/backward/optimizer/checkpoint. No DEV feedback/validation-best.
recipe.geometry_and_latent_graph: Recompute geometry/FNO once per fullCAD update, accumulate full-node head/latent/context gradients across chunks, one graph backward then optimizer; no stale graph or context cache across updates
recipe.evaluation: Both fixed endpoints, allN physicalU reused unchanged + direct signedS predictions for all5; persist both arms allDEV predictions before either DEV cachedS read. Primary allN per-case signedL2/hotspot top1% abs originalS; stable row tie order.
recipe.no_rescue: No q*tanh, sign formula, label alteration, width/loss/step/seed/mesh/grid sweep; no source exporter guessing; no science/resource preflight

gate.per_arm_complete_service_gate: Both DEV cases signedS relativeL2<0.25 AND hotspot relativeL2<0.25; missing/budget/backend candidate terminal negative
gate.global_component_justified: Global also passes complete service gate AND DEV meanS relativeL2 at least20% lower than identical-local baseline; positive baseline denominator required
gate.cheaper_local_choice: Local passes and global not justified => prefer local physical geometry decoder within this fullFE scope, no final architecture claim
gate.capacity_claim: Global has extra active FNO parameters/compute; component ablation only, not capacity matched and not isolated propagation causality

budget.accounting: Stage counts inherited original5 full GT-free physical+feature prep once plus every new actual wall including technicalfailed attempts/resume, no reset. Arm train overshoots and whole-stage limit explicit. No re-run physics/recovery/oldguards.
budget.cost_reporting: Cached neural incremental train/inference/setup separately; each deployment composed fullcold=its originalzero GT-free physical cold + original recovery/input prep + new input/model/context/grid/fullNdecode/persist. Never splice newcoarse costs or call composed cost fresh joint measurement. If either complete pass/prediction/cost missing retain negative, no extension.
